description: Move toward or away from the robot body-forward direction while Term1 keeps both arms in elbow60_hand60_carry_ready with live 60-degree palm backstops.
selection_guidance: The active goal is primarily along the measured body-forward axis and dual-robot hand/forearm support is stable.
preconditions: payload supported by front and back
no payload floor or wall contact

methods.name: carry_forward
methods.description: Walk body-frame forward with the carry arm pose fixed.

distance_m.description: nominal bounded segment length; model-generated loaded motion uses exactly 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1.0m

ramp_s.description: zero-speed settle before and after motion

methods.name: carry_backward
methods.description: Walk body-frame backward with the carry arm pose fixed.

distance_m.description: nominal bounded segment length; model-generated loaded motion uses exactly 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1.0m

ramp_s.description: zero-speed settle before and after motion

description: Rotate the robot body while keeping the upper-body carry pose fixed; clockwise and counterclockwise are explicit methods.
selection_guidance: Payload orientation or robot heading must change before the next translation segment.
preconditions: payload supported by front and back

methods.name: turn_clockwise
methods.description: Rotate clockwise as viewed from world +Z; the API converts the positive magnitude to negative SONIC yaw.

yaw_deg.description: requested clockwise rotation magnitude; model-generated route turns use exactly 10, 15, 20, or 30deg

methods.name: turn_counterclockwise
methods.description: Rotate counterclockwise as viewed from world +Z; the API converts the positive magnitude to positive SONIC yaw.

yaw_deg.description: requested counterclockwise rotation magnitude; model-generated route turns use exactly 10, 15, 20, or 30deg

description: Change a stationary loaded posture without commanding locomotion: lower or recover body height, or retract both arm supports when the box has slipped outward.
selection_guidance: Use crouch/stand at the placement region. Use payload-inward recovery only when live state shows positive body-forward support offset at the warning level and the current pose is elbow60_hand60_carry_ready.
preconditions: payload supported by front and back
both robots use one atomic sync phase

methods.name: place_crouch
methods.description: Lower both robots in place to a requested body height.

ramp_s.description: time used to lower toward the target height

methods.name: recover_stand
methods.description: Return both robots from the crouched posture to upright standing.

methods.name: recover_payload_inward
methods.description: Keep both robots idle while Term1 synchronously changes only the arm-lock targets from elbow60 to the conservative elbow50 recovery pose, moving the support surfaces rearward and slightly upward while live wrist control retains the 60-degree palm backstops.

description: Move sideways without first changing heading while Term1 keeps the carry arm pose fixed.
selection_guidance: The active goal or local clearance requires body-frame left/right translation rather than a heading change.
preconditions: payload supported by front and back
body-frame direction calibrated from measured world motion

methods.name: carry_lateral_left
methods.description: Walk toward each robot's current body-frame left side.

distance_m.description: nominal bounded segment length; model-generated loaded motion uses exactly 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1.0m

ramp_s.description: zero-speed settle before and after motion

methods.name: carry_lateral_right
methods.description: Walk toward each robot's current body-frame right side.

distance_m.description: nominal bounded segment length; model-generated loaded motion uses exactly 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, or 1.0m

ramp_s.description: zero-speed settle before and after motion
